title: Accepting Correction Gracefully
paragraphs: Ketika seorang rekan kerja junior menunjukkan kesalahan dalam laporannya selama rapat, Wahid merasa harga dirinya sedikit tersentak, terutama karena koreksi itu terjadi di depan seluruh tim.

Alih-alih mengabaikan komentar itu atau membela diri, ia berhenti sejenak, berterima kasih kepada rekan kerjanya karena menemukan kesalahan itu, dan mengajukan pertanyaan klarifikasi untuk sepenuhnya memahami kesalahannya sebelum memperbaikinya.
Setelah rapat, seorang manajer senior berkomentar secara pribadi bahwa respons Wahid yang anggun terhadap koreksi di depan umum lebih mengesankannya daripada kesalahan aslinya yang mengganggunya.

Wahid kemudian merenungkan bahwa menerima koreksi dengan rendah hati, alih-alih membela egonya, justru mendatangkan lebih banyak rasa hormat dari timnya daripada jika ia tidak pernah membuat kesalahan itu sama sekali.
answerKey: When a junior colleague pointed out a mistake in his report during a meeting, Wahid felt his pride sting momentarily, especially since the correction happened in front of the entire team. Instead of dismissing the comment or explaining it away, he paused, thanked the colleague for catching the error, and asked a clarifying question to fully understand the mistake before correcting it. After the meeting, a senior manager privately commented that Wahid's graceful response to being corrected publicly had impressed her more than the original mistake had bothered her. Wahid later reflected that accepting correction with humility, rather than defending his ego, actually earned him more respect from his team than if he had never made the mistake at all.
